resources.string: Requests the car’s full projection for the player. The visible result depends on firmware; native warning lights and alerts remain controlled by the car. Switches instantly and pauses map video and its center-screen copies.
Vehicle speed in km/h, without a box. Requires vehicle reading over ADB; shows — without recent data.
Gear, battery percentage and electric range, read through ADB. Unavailable or stale readings show —. Native warning lights and alerts are still required.

Temporary layout for clusters with top and bottom vehicle strips. Keeps the cover, song, speed and progress inside the visible area; the background still fills the projection. Applies immediately and does not hide native indicators.
